scope.assurance_scope: PCSM Python v1 API capability assessment for the exact current admitted source forest
scope.implementation_delta: The exact current accelerator head has a versioned ExternalHandoffAPI@1, but that API owns external-agent handoff operations and no PCSM semantic-minification input/output contract. Its generic SemanticProjectionStore@1 and ProofProjectionStore@1 persist opaque tree-bound references while explicitly refusing to reinterpret semantics or mint authority. The searched source and PCSM test forests contain no PCSM Python API, PCSM ProjectionRoot, PCSM source-map CID, or SourceLinkReceipt identifier. PCSM-046, PCSM-057, and PCSM-085 independently record the same missing PCSM projection/source-map chain. The declared authority permits only this receipt, so no wrapper, alias, competing API, schema, CID, or test alteration was created.
scope.non_promotion_reason: No current-head PCSM API package is available to qualify. The required suite supplies structured-output boundary coverage only, not direct PCSM API positive/negative vectors. A sealed direct import of the closest generic projection modules is blocked by the absent anyio dependency before its assertions can execute. Consequently neither generic API behavior nor the passing required suite is relabelled as a PCSM API implementation, semantic authority, CID binding, or promotion.
